_about: Public-domain Rowland Hill (1744-1833, evangelical preacher of Surrey Chapel, London; not Sir Rowland Hill of the penny post) for the Word Hoard: Village Dialogues (2 vols, Tegg, 1825), his Journal of a Tour through the North of England and Scotland (1799) and its sequel (1800), Christ Crucified (the sermon at the opening of Surrey Chapel; RTS, catalogued 1839), A Collection of Psalms and Hymns (catalogued 1787), and Edwin Sidney's Life (3rd ed., 1835) and Select Notes of his preaching (1837), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 17 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

rhill-village-dialogues-1: Village Dialogues, vol. 1, twenty-fourth edition (London: Thomas Tegg, 1825)
rhill-village-dialogues-2: Village Dialogues, vol. 2, twenty-second edition (London: Thomas Tegg, 1825)
rhill-journal-1799: Journal of a Tour through the North of England and Parts of Scotland (1799; long-s OCR)
rhill-second-tour-1800: Extract of a Journal of a Second Tour (London: A. Paris, 1800; long-s OCR)
rhill-christ-crucified: Christ Crucified, the sermon at the opening of Surrey Chapel, 1783 (London: Religious Tract Society; catalogued 1839)
rhill-psalms-hymns: A Collection of Psalms and Hymns, chiefly intended for public worship (London, sold at Surrey Chapel; catalogued 1787)
rhill-sidney-life-1835: The Life of the Rev. Rowland Hill, by Edwin Sidney, third edition (London: Baldwin & Cradock, 1835)
rhill-select-notes-1837: Select Notes of the Preaching of the late Rev. Rowland Hill, by Edwin Sidney (London: Baldwin and Cradock, 1837)

_alternates.rhill-jones-memoir: Memoir by William Jones, 3rd ed. (Bohn, 1845; IA revrowla00jone)

rhill-psalms-hymns.author: Title page read: "By R O W L A N D HILL, A. M.", London: L. Wayland, sold at the Surry Chapel, 1787; OCR spaces the letters.
